items.title: Decorative Reindeer Crossing Sign
items.alt: Red-and-green wooden holiday sign reading REINDEER CROSSING, with a prancing reindeer silhouette and a gold bell above.
items.description: A carved gold border frames the two-line wording on a striped post. Pine sprigs, holly and a red bow make the complete sign clearly decorative.

items.title: Three Felt Reindeer Face Garland
items.alt: Garland of three different felt reindeer faces linked with gold stars and holly, with bow-tied hanging loops at both ends.
items.description: A cream smiling face sits between two brown faces with different ears, antlers and expressions. Red and green knitted scarf details brighten the small hanging decoration.

items.title: Reindeer Lowering Its Head to Lichen
items.alt: Brown-and-cream reindeer lowering its broad muzzle toward a small isolated lichen sprig, with full antlers and four sturdy legs.
items.description: A thick pale neck ruff follows the downward angle of the head. Irregular antler branches and broad cloven hooves distinguish the animal's sturdy natural silhouette.

items.title: Reindeer Walking in Profile
items.alt: Gray-brown reindeer walking left in profile with one forehoof lifted, a thick cream neck ruff and long branched antlers.
items.description: The full side view shows a short tail, broad muzzle and pale flank stripe. Four distinct legs and wide cloven hooves keep the walking anatomy clear.

items.title: Adult Reindeer with a Resting Calf
items.alt: Adult brown-and-cream reindeer standing behind a small dark-coated calf resting with folded legs, both complete figures.
items.description: The adult's wide antler crown and thick pale neck contrast with the calf's smooth, antlerless head. Their different sizes and overlapping positions form a compact wildlife pair.

items.title: Reindeer Resting and Looking Back
items.alt: Pale winter-coated reindeer resting with folded legs and looking back over its shoulder beneath long branching antlers.
items.description: Cream and gray fur follow the curve of the animal's sturdy body. A broad dark muzzle, short pale tail and tucked cloven hooves distinguish the quiet resting pose.
